paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: : Modality Distribution
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the modality distribution across various audio categories in the MMAR benchmark dataset, categorized by the presence of speech, music, sound, or their combinations. The chart is divided into seven segments, each labeled with its corresponding category and percentage. The largest segment is "Speech" at 29.4%, represented in a medium purple shade. Following that is "Mix-Sound-Speech" at 21.8% and "Music" at 20.6%, both in lighter purple tones. "Sound" accounts for 16.5% and is shown in a pale lavender color. The "Mix-Music-Speech" category comprises 8.2% and is depicted in a darker purple. Two smaller segments are "Mix-Sound-Music-Speech" at 2.4% and "Mix-Sound-Music" at 1.1%, both in very light purple and visually emphasized by thin lines extending from the chart to their labels. All percentages are explicitly labeled within or adjacent to their respective slices, and the chart uses a donut-style format with a white center. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-right, with the largest slice ("Speech") occupying the right side of the chart.
